info.title: Psikita Core API
info.description:
REST API for the Psikita mental-health platform.

## Conventions

- **Authentication:** protected endpoints use the `access-token` bearer scheme.
- **Validation:** invalid request data returns `422 Unprocessable Entity` with per-field details under `messages`.
- **Audit trail:** mutation endpoints (`POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, and `DELETE`) are logged automatically.
- **Pagination:** list endpoints return `data` and a `meta` object with one-based page information.
- **Tags:** use the domain or resource name in Title Case; managed resources are pluralized, while capability and acronym tags keep their established singular form.
- **Identifiers:** resource identifiers are opaque strings and must be treated as case-sensitive.
